name: Streaming Agentic Proxies Governance Accountability And The Architecture Of A Trus 31Dc1E30C1
text: Geoff Lundholm qualifies Kaal's source-bound position through Agentic Proxies: Governance, Accountability, and the Architecture of a Trustworthy AI Economy [Working Draft -June 2026]. The indexed proposition states that none establish whether a delegated action remained continuously authorised across a multi-agent workflow. This bears on Kaal's claim that representation is built into the framework: one Legal Identity can authorize another as its agent to create or change legal statuses and acts on its behalf by using that identifier, which is how delegated and automated action is attributed to a principal. The source identifies continuous authorization across multi-agent workflows as an unresolved requirement, qualifying Kaal's representation mechanism with a continuity condition. The response is limited to the indexed proposition and does not imply review of the full external work.
